contact.name: Teresa Pallarés-Ramos
contact.designation: Head of Advocacy and Coordinator of Programmes
contact.evidence_quote: Teresa Pallarés-Ramos (Spain, 1989). Head of Advocacy and Coordinator of Programmes. She started her career in Brussels at the Directorate General of Home Affairs and Migration (European Commission), the European Leadership Programme, and Caritas Europa. She is a historian by training, with postgraduate degrees in International Relations, International Migration, and Education and International Development. She has conducted research at the Spanish Office of Asylum and Refugees, the Laudato Si’

alternates.name: Paloma Cantero Gómez
alternates.evidence_quote: Paloma Cantero Gómez (Spain, 1989), CEO of YouthProAktiv. She is an expert in international relations, holding a double bachelor degree in law and journalism by the University of Madrid Rey Juan Carlos and Sciences-Po (Paris). Her professional career started with the Spanish law firm Cremades & Calvo-Sotelo focused on political campaigns and the financial sector.
